note: RFC 4271 Section 9.2 forbids redistributing routes received from an internal peer to other internal peers unless acting as a Route Reflector. TestRFC4271NoIBGPToIBGPRedistribution (RS forward rail) and TestRFC4271ForwardRailNeverRedistributesInternalRoutesToInternalPeers (general forward rail) fan out a received non-client iBGP route to non-client iBGP, eBGP, and RR-client iBGP peers, asserting nothing is sent to the non-client iBGP peer while eBGP and RR-client receive the exact prefix; TestRFC4271IBGPRedistributionAllowedForReflectorClient verifies an RR-client iBGP source reflects to non-client iBGP.
